basic_info.description: Located in San Francisco's Central Richmond district, this delightful Edwardian cottage offers timeless charm, abundant space, incredible natural light and an unbeatable location just half a block from Golden Gate Park. Situated on a large RH-2 lot (25'x127', per tax records), this home boasts a bright and spacious living/dining area with a cozy fireplace and sliding doors that open to a generous deck overlooking a level, private backyard. The property features several system upgrades and includes owned solar. The kitchen includes a charming breakfast nook with built-in benches and large windows that bring in natural light and provide serene views of the yard. A convenient bedroom and half bath are located on the main level. Upstairs, you'll find three rooms (two bedrooms) and a full bath, offering flexible living options. A full basement includes parking, laundry, and ample storage. A standout feature is the detached artist's studio at the back of the lot, complete with skylights, perfect as a home office or creative workspace. With easy access to 19th Avenue and Marin County, and surrounded by parks, shops, and cultural attractions, this home is a rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's architectural history with endless potential.
